description: RF-104G on a pole beside Black Forest Airport, painted in Canadian Armed Forces CF-104 colours without a code. It carries the tail of RF-104G 24+11. Refurbished in summer 2015 (International F-104 Society; 916-starfighter German fate list, 2025).
